name: Admin Document Folders
description: Organize admin documents with two collapsible root sections: lifecycle-managed project roots under Proyectos and operator-created roots under Carpetas. Project roots display the project's current state, do not expose rename/archive/delete/reorder controls, and remain valid parents for manually created subfolders. The default project list follows each project state's show_in_document_manager configuration; excluded projects remain reachable through Ver todos. In the folder manager modal, the 'Nueva carpeta' form's 'Dentro de:' parent selector defaults to the currently active folder. Document state filtering remains an independent axis covered by admin-document-state-filters.
